title: Infirmary
shortDescription: Honey-coloured light warms clean beds and folded blankets.
longDescription:
Sunlight falls through linen curtains onto two neatly made beds. The room smells of soap, rosemary, and warm beeswax; even the cabinet doors seem to close softly.
Healer Fen folds a bandage with the care another person might give a map. A painted breathing wheel hangs where anyone resting can see it.

fixtures.name: Healer Fen
fixtures.lookDescription: An otter with rolled sleeves, gentle paws, and a very orderly bandage basket. Try talk fen.
fixtures.examineDescription: Fen's apron is spotless except for a small embroidered fish. He has the reassuring habit of putting down whatever he is holding when someone speaks. A label on his honey jar says 'For tea, not experiments'.
fixtures.dialogue: "Rest and ask for help when you need it. Nobody earns extra courage by pretending not to hurt." Fen glances at a pot of moonmint. "Helping Tansy? Those roots need air as well as water. Clear the drainage and use a clean jug; never add mysterious potions to an unhappy plant."

fixtures.name: Breathing Wheel
fixtures.examineDescription: The wheel shows a leaf opening, resting, and closing. Around its edge: 'Sit if you need to. Breathe at your own pace. Tell someone when you are hurt.' A pencilled addition says: 'Courage includes asking for help.'
